title: NFL, Roger Goodell reverse course on Jalen Hurts’ inquiry after NFLPA demand

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: NFL, Roger Goodell reverse course on Jalen Hurts’ inquiry after NFLPA demand
sources.description: The NFL said there'd be no investigation into Jalen Hurts' medical treatment for blood clots. Roger Goodell said that's changing after a union request.
